milestones.title: Evidence-first delivery controller operational
milestones.intent: Prove that the KB cannot be completed from a static registry or an unverified claim.
entry_conditions: The repository contains the KB registry and controller.

proof_contract.real_surface: The executable KB controller validating the tracked registry.

milestones.title: Shared T480 retrieval dependencies proven
milestones.intent: Prove that the private shared PostgreSQL/pgvector, Docker network, and local bge-m3 runtime are reachable through governed read-only operations.
entry_conditions: T480 key-authenticated control path is configured.

proof_contract.real_surface: The existing T480 shared lab services, checked through the fixed KB adapter.

milestones.title: KB deployment and schema proven
milestones.intent: Deploy only application containers onto the existing T480 network and apply the reviewed schema through the shared governed PostgreSQL adapter.
entry_conditions: Explicit approval exists for the shared database migration and application deployment.

proof_contract.real_surface: T480 deployed operator UI/API, options_learning_kb schema, and application container health.

milestones.title: Private approved transcript retrieval proven
milestones.intent: Ingest one real approved private transcript and independently read back source, document, chunks, ingest run, and expected cited retrieval.
entry_conditions: A real reviewed transcript and permission basis are available privately.

proof_contract.real_surface: Private KB database and read-only retrieval API.

milestones.title: Retrieval QA and gap handling proven
milestones.intent: Prove a small QA pack retrieves expected timestamped passages and an unsupported question creates a visible gap without an invented answer.
entry_conditions: Private QA questions and expected timestamps are available.

proof_contract.real_surface: Private Test Lab records and retrieval API results.

milestones.title: Options Decision Agent read-only integration proven
milestones.intent: Prove a versioned read-only retrieval contract supplies cited learning context without changing deterministic policy or execution state.
entry_conditions: A mutually tested API contract is committed in both repositories.

proof_contract.real_surface: Deployed KB API and Options Decision Agent integration runtime.
